android.releaseNotes:
• WhatsApp Chat Architecture: Resilient local outbox persistence with automatic FIFO retry on reconnect, one-tap retry on failed messages, and active typing presence.
• WhatsApp Micro-Animations: 4-stage status icons (clock -> single check -> double grey check -> blue check -> red error) and directional bubble entrance animations.
• Editorial Feed App Bar: Sleek brand wordmark with instant feed/layout switcher sheet, quick Ripples launcher, Create post button, and live Notifications bell with unread badge.
• UI Polish & Performance: High-framerate GPU-composited chat animations and native frosted glass header scroll physics.
